bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomProductCategoryField f JOIN EcomFieldType t ON t.FieldTypeId = f.FieldType WHERE ISNULL(t.FieldTypeProvider, N'') <> N'' AND f.FieldCategoryId <> N'reference_category') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomProductField p JOIN EcomFieldType t ON t.FieldTypeId = p.ProductFieldTypeId WHERE ISNULL(t.FieldTypeProvider, N'') <> N'')
